text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Uwoooooh! Not done yettt!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"This is where my tactical plan really 
heats up...! Go beyond imagination, push 
past limits—blaze on, my pen!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after training finished, Kiseki 
continued formulating plans for her next 
race. The look on her face was dead 
serious.
choice_data_list: You seem even more fired up than usual.

You seem even more fired up than usual, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, naturally! After all, there are 
people waiting for my work!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: For example... just like this little one!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I got this letter from an elementary 
school kid. ...They said they're a huge 
fan of mine."

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
"—Dear Kiseki, Thank you so much for 
always giving us such thrilling races to 
watch!"

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
“Kiseki-san always shows us such 
unpredictable running! It gets my heart 
racing every time!”

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
"Your last race was incredible too! Right 
from the start, you went whooosh to the 
front! I was so surprised—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's not over yet... Look! It's filled 
right down to the very end of the page!
choice_data_list: Amazing! They must be a huge fan of yours.
Amazing! They must be a huge fan of yours.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...Heheh♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...She must've had so many things she 
wanted to tell me."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I know the feeling myself, after all.

text_block_list.name: Young Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Um, um... Oh, right! Please take good 
care of your health and keep drawing lots 
of manga for us...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. Kiseki, could that be the fan 
letter to the manga artist you were 
talking about before? ...My goodness!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"There are so many words packed in here! 
It's amazing how much effort you put into 
writing this!"

text_block_list.name: Young Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yeah. ...I was writing about my 
favorite episodes and the protagonist, and 
before I knew it, it was totally filled 
up..."

text_block_list.name: Young Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Because Sensei's manga is so fun... and I 
love it so much...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, how nostalgic.
choice_data_list: So you had a time like that too, huh?
So you had a time like that too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"So, um... I wondered if the girl who 
wrote this letter was feeling the exact 
same way I did back then, or something..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"When I thought of that, a fire lit inside 
me...! I just couldn't sit still 
anymore...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! I'll flesh out the concept for 
my next piece just a little bit more! 
Let's do this, me!
choice_data_list:
For the fans who are looking forward to 
it!

It's all for the fans who are looking 
forward to it, right!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll put my all into my next work 
too—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Delivering the best work possible to the 
readers! That is the greatest way an 
author can repay them!
